docTitle: Deftere Seniinde e karta · Deftere Seniinde e gite goo
metaDesc: Tokku jamaanuuji Aliyani Hindi, ngurndan Iisaa, e laabi Pool e karta goonga — Deftere Seniinde kewi e nokkuuje goonga.

s.kicker: Deftere Seniinde e gite goo · Kartaaji
s.title: Deftere Seniinde e karta
s.verse: “Awa, hinaa men ɓaarorɓe taariikaaji sinciraaɗi ƴoyre, fewndo ko men ɓanginani on ardu Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on e bawgal makko ngal. Kono men yi'irii gite amen ɗen tigi mangu makko ngun.” (2 Piyer 1:16)
s.purpose: Deftere Seniinde wanaa taalol fiymti. Ko daari yimɓe yaawii e nokkuuje, balɗe, e inɗe goonga. Tokku ɗii laabi e karta, e laawol jamaanu — ɗotta e nokkuure, maa ɗotta ▶ ngam yahde ɗum tabital e tabital.
s.ot_lead: Wanaa laawol gootol kono ko ɓuli daari dandeede gila tagugol: tagugol e yanugol → waame e Baabel → noddaango (Ibraahiima) → leydi aadaandi → Yaltugol → ladde → foolugol → laamu → seergol → horeede → artugol.
s.je_lead: Tokku ngurndan Iisaa wano Linjiilaaji habrata, e laawol — daga jibineede makko Baytalami rewa lootagol makko e kuugal Galili, rewa Samariiya, haa leggal altindiraangal, ummital, e ƴiwugol Urusaliima.
s.pa_h: Daga Antiyaakiya haa kattuɗe leyɗe — Roma
s.pa_lead: Daga Pentekot Urusaliima, no Kibaaru Moƴƴo saakornoo yaha caggal Yahuudiya — rewa Asiya Tokoora e Eropa haa ɓernde laamu ngun. Suɓo gootol e laabi jowi (aranol·ɗiɗaɓol·tataɓol + laawol faade Roma + ɓaawo rimɗineede) tokkaa kuuɗe Kuuɗe Nelaaɓe wondude e ɓataakuuji winndaaɗi e laawol.
s.foot: Iwdiiji · Nokkuuje ɗen njokkii binndol Deftere Seniinde e karta Deftere Seniinde jaɓaaɗo (e inɗe hannde ka nafata). Daanɗe maaje, maaje e weendaaji ndiwtaa e keɓe leydi udditiiɗe (Natural Earth), newnaaɗe.
s.contact: Naamne · miijooji — Windan min imeel

eden.name: Eden (Tagugol · Yanugol)
eden.note: E aduna tagaandu «moƴƴungu no feewi», junuubu naati o taƴi jokkere hakkunde Alla e yimɓe.
events: Tagugol e balɗe jeegoo — «ɗun moƴƴi»
Neɗɗo tagaa e mbaadi Alla
Yanugol e junuubu, e riiweede daga Eden
Aadi Kibaaru Moƴƴo aranol — «ɓiɗɗo debbo on helay hoore mboddi»

noah.name: Araraat (Waame on)
noah.note: Alla ñaawi aduna heewndu junuubu, kono o reeni ngurndan e ɓeynguure wootere.
events: Aduna heewndu bone
Waame on, e laana Nuuhu
Aadi seedee weyngo — «waame wartataa bonnude aduna fahin»

babel.name: Sinannde Baabel
babel.note: E mawningol ngol ɗaɓɓi dow kammu, Alla saaki ɗemngal maɓɓe e leƴƴi ɗin e hoore leydi.
events: «Ngaɗen wuro e sinannde… waɗen innde men»
Alla jiibi ɗemngal maɓɓe
Leƴƴi ɗin saakii e hoore leydi (Sineyaar — ɓaawo Baabila)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Daari dandeede Deftere Seniinde fuɗɗoroo noddugol gorko gooto.
events: Alla noddi Ibraahiima daga Ur Kaldankooɓe
«Mi waɗay ma leñol mawngol… leƴƴi fow keɓay barki e maaɗa»
Sabu gomɗinal o yalti leydi mun

haran.name: Haaraan
haran.note: E laawol, jaabotoo noddaango ngam leydi aadaandi.
events: Ɓeynguure Teraa hoɗi Haaraan
Teraa maayi
Ibraahiima yalti faade Kanaana e duuɓi 75

shechem.name: Sekem · Kanaana
shechem.note: E leydi aadaandi ɓeynguure sinkaa e aadi on jokkondiri jamaanuuji.
events: Naatugol Kanaana, sadakirde arande — «mi hokkay ɓiɓɓe maaɗa ndii leydi»
Aadi on (Laawol Fuɗɗoode 15) · Isiyaaka · Yaaquuba
Ɓiɓɓe Yaaquuba sappo e ɗiɗo — ɗaɗol leƴƴi sappo e ɗiɗi

egypt.name: Misira (Gosen)
egypt.note: Ɓeynguure wontii leñol mawngol — refti leñol maccuɓe.
events: Yuusufu, jeeyaaɗo, ƴawi haa laamu Misira
Ɓeynguure Yaaquuba fow jippii ngam dogde heege
Leñol Isra'iila ɓeydotoongol waɗaa maccuɓe

sinai.name: Fello Sinaa'i
sinai.note: Dandugol ɓurngol mawnude e Aliyani Hindi — maccuɓe wontii leñol Alla tigi.
events: Bone sappo e baalii Juldeere Yawtaneede
Maayo Boɗeewo seeri ɓe lummbi
Yamirooje sappo, Sariya, suudu tukuru e sadakaaji

kadesh.name: Kadees (ladde)
kadesh.note: Ɗoftaaki majjini jamaanu leydi ndin — kono Alla heddii wondude e maɓɓe.
events: Yuurnitooɓe sappo e ɗiɗo — kono yimɓe ɓen njeddi gomɗingol
Duuɓi 38 e ladde — manna, duule e yiite
E seeno Mowaab, waaju sakkitiiɗo Muusaa (Laawol Sariya)

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: Ka lannoode ɓe naati ɓe keɓi leydi aadaandi.
events: Maayo Yurdun seeri yimɓe ɓen lummbi
Galɗe Yeriko yani
Foolugol Kanaana e senndugol leydi ndin

shiloh.name: Silo (Ɲaawooɓe)
shiloh.note: Walaa laamɗo, kala neɗɗo waɗay ko yiɗi — laamɗo goonga no ɗaɓɓaa.
events: Suudu tukuru darnaa Silo
Yiilannde junuubu–torra–dandeede (Debora, Gideyuuna, Samsuuna)
Ruutu — hoolaare e balɗe niɓɓe, e jamaanu Daawuuda

jerusalem.name: Urusaliima · Laamu woortungu
jerusalem.note: Jamaanu ɓurngu Isra'iila — e aadi laamɗo poomayankeejo.
events: Sawuula laamɗo aranɗo, refti Daawuuda e Goliyaata
Aadi Daawuuda — «jullere laamu maaɗa heddoto poomaa» (Samuweela 2: 7)
Sulaymaana mahi hekkalu Urusaliima

samaria.name: Samariiya · Laamu seerngu
samaria.note: Laamu seeri ngu yahi bonude tuma Annabaaɓe rentini.
events: Ɓaawo Sulaymaana, seergol e Yahuuda e Isra'iila
Rewugol sanamuuji jokkindirngol
Iliyaasu, Isaaya, Irimiyaa noddi «ngartee» — ɓe habri Almasiihu

nineveh.name: Ninawa (Asuuriya)
nineveh.note: E ɓe ndeenaaki kala rentinaango, rewo on yani ko adii.
events: Ninawa, hekkalu Asuuriya
Laamu rewo ngun yani e Asuuriya (722 H.A.)
Yuunus nelaa Ninawa

babylon.name: Baabila
babylon.note: Jemma ɓurɗo niɓɓude — kono aadi artugol heddii.
events: Urusaliima yani, hekkalu sumaa (586 H.A.)
Yahuuda njaɓɓinaa Baabila
Daani'eela e Hazaqiyeela — gomɗinal e wahayuuji e horeede

susa.name: Suusa (Persiya)
susa.note: Hay e ɓernde laamu heefereeɓe, Alla no reena leñol mun.
events: Persiya fooli Baabila
Esteer dandi Yahuudinaaɓe e bonugol
Nehemiya du'ii yeeso laamɗo o nelaa

return.name: Artugol Urusaliima
return.note: Ɓe ngarti ɓe mahti — kono laamɗo waraali. Ɓe habbii Almasiihu.
events: Lummbe tati artugol e kongol Sirus (Zerubabel 538 · Ezra 458 · Nehemiya 444)
Hekkalu mahtaa e galɗe Urusaliima mahtaa
Malaaki — Aliyani Hindi joofi: «Mi lilay nelaaɗo an»

bethlehem.name: Baytalami
bethlehem.note: Almasiihu aadaaɗo on ari e saare Daawuuda — Daaluyee on wonti neɗɗo.
events: Jibinaaɗo Baytalami, saare Daawuuda
Malaa'ikaaɓe njeeyani aynaaɓe kabaaru on
Annduɓe koode ari ngam sujjude

nazareth.name: Nasareti
nazareth.note: Alla mawni wa neɗɗo e saare hoyfere.
events: Ne'aa e galle gollotooɗo leɗɗe
E duuɓi sappo e ɗiɗi, o naamnii o jaabii ka hekkalu
Ɓaawo o riiwaa ka sinagog saare mun

jordan.name: Maayo Yurdun
jordan.note: Kuugal makko ka yimɓe fuɗɗii — kammu seedii mo wa Ɓiɗɗo on.
events: Lootaa e junngo Yuhanna
Ruuhu on jippii wa foondu — «Ko oo woni Ɓiɗɗo an jiɗaaɗo»
O fooli jarrabuuji tati Seyɗaan e ladde

cana.name: Kaana
cana.note: E maandeere makko arande o hollii teddungal makko.
events: Koɗo e dewgal
Ndiyam wontii sanngara — maandeere makko arande
Taalibaaɓe makko ngomɗini mo

sychar.name: Sikaar (Samariiya)
sychar.note: Laawol kuugal aranol — rewa Urusaliima haa Samariiya jaasnaandi.
events: O laɓɓini hekkalu ka Urusaliima
Jemma, Nikodemu — «Sey a jibinee hesii»
Ndiyam nguurɗam wonande debbo Samariyanke

capernaum.name: Kafarnahum
capernaum.note: Ñiiɓirde kuugal Galili — noddugol, janngingol e luutndagol fow tawtoroo ɗoo.
events: O noddi awooɓe liƴƴi o ñiiɓi ɗoo
Waaju ka fello — «Barkinaaɓe ko waasɓe e ruuhu»
Misalaaji laamu ngun — e luutndagol ɓeydotoongol

galilee.name: Weendu Galili
galilee.note: E bawgal makko dow tageefe, o hollii ko o woni.
events: «Deƴƴu, tamño» — o deeƴni henndu ndun
O ñamminii 5.000 e mburu jowi e liƴƴi ɗiɗi
O yaha dow ndiyam

caesarea_p.name: Kaysariya Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Taalibaaɓe ɓen faami ko o Almasiihu on, e laawol leggal altindiraangal udditii.
events: Qirritaango Piyer — «An woni Almasiihu on, Ɓiɗɗo Alla wuuɗo on»
O habri arannde mayde makko e ummital makko
O waylii mbaadi e teddungal ka fello

jericho.name: Yeriko
jericho.note: E laawol ƴawugol Urusaliima, o ɗaɓɓi majjuɓe ɓen.
events: O udditi gite bumɗo Bartimeyus
O noddi Sakkeyu mooɓtoowo lampo
«Ɓiɗɗo neɗɗo on ari ɗaɓɓude e dandude majjuɓe ɓen»

bethany.name: Baytaaniya
bethany.note: O hollii bawgal makko dow mayde ka jonte makko sakkitiinde ɓadii.
events: O ummini Laasar daga yanaande — «Ko min woni ummital ngal e ngurndan ɗan»
Maryama wujii mo nebbam ngam ubbugol
Ndee maandeere ɓeydi feere warugol mo

jerusalem.name: Urusaliima
jerusalem.note: Ɓatte ɗe Deftere Seniinde fow joopii — leggal altindiraangal, ummital, ƴiwugol.
events: Naatugol teddungal; o wayliti taabaljaaji hekkalu fahin
Ka Hiraande Sakkitiinde o lootii koyɗe taalibaaɓe
O maayi ka leggal altindiraangal
Ummitii ñalaande tataɓere, refti ƴiwi

antioch.name: Antiyaakiya
antioch.note: Fedde diina nelooru nde misiyon leƴƴi goɗɗi fuɗɗii e artata.
events: E du'aaji Ruuhu on senndi Barnaba e Sawuula
Fedde diina nde gomɗinɓe njeydaa «Almasiihankooɓe» ko adii
Fuɗɗorde laabi aranɗi, ɗiɗaɓi e tataɓi

seleucia.name: Selesiya
seleucia.note: Marsa Antiyaakiya — ɓe ngummii faade Kupurus.

salamis.name: Salaamis (Kupurus)
salamis.note: Darnde arande Kupurus — waajagol ka sinagogaaji.

paphos.name: Paafos
paphos.note: Bawgal hollaa e ɓen luutndotooɓe Kibaaru Moƴƴo.
events: Elimas mbileejo waɗaa bumɗo
Serjiyus Pool gomna on gomɗinii
Gila ɗoo «Pool» ardii

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: Marsa e Pamfiliya — ɗoo Yuhanna Markus rutti caggal.

pantioch.name: Antiyaakiya Pisidiya
pantioch.note: Kibaaru Moƴƴo udditii faade leƴƴi goɗɗi.
events: Waaju juutɗo dow daari dandeede ka sinagog
Leƴƴi goɗɗi keewɗi mbeltii ɓe njaɓi Kongol on
Riiwaa sabu luutndagol

iconium.name: Ikoniyum
iconium.note: Heewɓe ngomɗini, kono torra waɗi ɓe njokka.

lystra.name: Listara
lystra.note: Teddinaa wa reweteeɗo, refti fiyaa kaaƴe.
events: O sellini gorko mo waawaano yahde gila jibineede
Jamaa on ɗaɓɓi hirsande ɓe wa reweteeɓe
Fiyaa kaaƴe accaa wa maayɗo, o ummii

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: Taalibaaɓe heewɓe ngaɗaa; ɓe ngarti ka ɓe ngummornoo ngam semmbinde feddeeji diina.

troas.name: Torowaas
troas.note: Nokkuure baylol ka Kibaaru Moƴƴo huccitii Eropa ko adii.
events: Wahayu gorko Makeduuniya
«Ar Makeduuniya ballaa min»
E jaka ɓe lummbi njaadi Eropa

philippi.name: Filipi
philippi.note: Fedde diina arande Eropa — Kibaaru Moƴƴo fooli hay ka kaso.
events: Lidiya, jeeyoowo bagiiji purpur, gomɗinii
Suka debbo maccuɗo tefoowo rimɗinaa
Gimɗi ka feccere jemma, dilol leydi, ɓeynguure deenoowo kaso dandaa

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: Kongol on dimbini saare nden e luutndagol fasii.
events: O yeewti ka sinagog Sabbatuuji tati
«Ɓee waylooɓe aduna on»
Ɓe njalti jemma

berea.name: Bere
berea.note: «Tedduɓe» ɓen ɓe ndaari Kongol on hoore maɓɓe.
events: Ɓe njaɓiri Kongol on e yiɗɗe
Ñalnde kala ɓe ndaari Bindi ɗin ngam ƴeewde ɗum
Heewɓe ngomɗini

athens.name: Ateen
athens.note: E saare falsafaaɓe o habri «reweteeɗo mo anndaaka».
events: Ɓernde makko dimbaa e saare heewndu sanamuuji
Ka Areyopagus o waaji Tagɗo on e ummital
O jalkitaa, kono seeɗaaɓe ngomɗini

corinth.name: Korinti
corinth.note: O ñiiɓi hitaande e feccere, o aawi fedde diina e saare bone.
events: O waɗi tiilaaji wondude e Akila e Prisilla
«Wata a hulu… ko fii miɗo wondi e maaɗa»
Korintinaaɓe heewɓe ngomɗini ɓe lootaa

ephesus.name: Efesu
ephesus.note: Ɓernde laawol tataɓol — Kongol on saakii e Asiya.
events: Janngingol ñalnde kala duuɓi ɗiɗi ka suudu Tirannus
Defte mbilewu cumaa; golle bawɗe
Demetiriyus tammoowo kaalis fuɗɗini fitina

miletus.name: Mile
miletus.note: Sallminaango gonɗi wondude e mawɓe Efesu.
events: «Reenee fedde diina nde o soodiri ƴiiƴan makko»
Mawɓe ɓen ngulli, ɓe nganndi ɓe ngi'ataa mo fahin

caesarea.name: Kaysariya
caesarea.note: Duuɓi ɗiɗi o wallitii Kibaaru Moƴƴo yeeso gomnaaji e laamɗo.
events: Ñaawooje yeeso gomnaaji Feliks e Festus
Daɗndagol makko yeeso laamɗo Agriipa
«Mi ɗaɓɓii ñaawoore Kaysar» — faade Roma

jerusalem.name: Urusaliima
jerusalem.note: Nanngaa ka hekkalu, laawol makko wa dahaaɗo fuɗɗii.
events: Nanngaa e jamaa ka hekkalu
O daɗndii hoore mun yeeso batu on
Wa ɓiɗɗo leydi Roma, nelaa e deenanooɓe faade Kaysariya

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: Ɓe eggii e laana Alesanderiya faaɗe Roma.

fairhaven.name: Marsaaji Moƴƴi (Kereeti)
fairhaven.note: Rentinaango Pool ngam dartaade doggu maayo ndeenaaka.

crete.name: Kereeti
crete.note: Ɓaawo o rimɗinaa, duungal ngal o acci Titu ngam feewnude feddeeji diina.
events: O acci Titu ngam toɗɗaade mawɓe e kala saare
O ɗaɓɓi ardiiɓe ɓe walaa ella, hoolniiɓe
O winda ɓataake Titu on

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Rewa henndu e yolɓugol laana, aadi Alla tabbiti.
events: Henndu «funnaange-rewo» yolɓini laana, kono 276 fow ndaɗi
Ñaɓɓaa mboddi, o gaañaaki
O sellini nawnaaɓe duungal ngal

puteoli.name: Puteyoli
puteoli.note: Ɓe njippii Itali ɓe njaɓɓaa e siɗɗiraaɓe gomɗinɓe.

rome.name: Roma
rome.note: Kibaaru Moƴƴo yottii ɓernde laamu ngun ka lannoode — wanaa joofnde kono ko fuɗɗoode.
events: Duuɓi ɗiɗi dahaaɗo ka galle, o habra laamu ngun e cuusal
Gila ɗoo o winda Ɓataakuuji Kaso (Efesinaaɓe·Filipinaaɓe·Kolosinaaɓe·Filemon)
Ɓaawo o dahaa fahin, o winda Timote 2 o waraa sabu gomɗinal — «Mi haɓii haɓannde moƴƴere nden, mi timminii doggu ngun»
